title: John Alexander's paranormal research in 92 countries, including Mongolia

tellings.quote: and he's been to 90 92 countries >> doing um research into everything from churches to ceremonies in Mongolia the reindeer herders

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says unexplained lights appear around him, says that John Alexander, a researcher of the paranormal, has travelled to some 90 to 92 countries for his work. According to Bledsoe, that research has ranged from churches to ceremonies of the reindeer herders in Mongolia, showing how widely Alexander has looked for these experiences.
